description: Native Windows herdr-core frames, captured on the Windows machine and scrubbed. Each case's source names its route: most came through a local `herdr-core connect` child, and foreground-*-form, finished-*-form and put-over-8-mib came over the named pipe directly. Provisional: the same bytes have not yet crossed an SSH exec channel to that machine (#586). Hex strings hold exact bytes; a frame is channel (u32 LE), kind (u8) and length (u32 LE) before its payload.
